purpose_context: The analyzer scans codex command output for failure signatures, but codex surfaces file reads and inspections (cat, grep, git diff) as ordinary command output whose content — source, diffs, PR bodies — often contains error-like words, producing false-positive failure detections. This mission teaches the analyzer to recognize codex read/inspection calls and exclude their content from failure scanning while still catching genuine command failures, so failure reports for codex sessions are trustworthy. Closes #13 and finishes the codex payload-type mapping from #11.
purpose_tldr: Stop the analyzer from flagging false failures on codex file-read/inspection output that merely contains error-like text.
